scripts.clean: rm -rf allure-results test-results allure-report reports videos
scripts.test:parallel: npm run clean && pytest -n auto --env prod elite-headed
scripts.test:cross-browser: npm run clean && pytest -n 4 --browser chromium --browser firefox --env qa --alluredir=allure-results
scripts.elite-parallel: npm eun clean && npm run test:parallel ; npm run report
scripts.elite-run: npm run clean && npm run test:cross-browser ; allure serve allure-results
scripts.test:headed: pytest --env prod --alluredir=allure-results --headed --browser chromium && npm run report
scripts.elite-headed: npm run clean && npm run test:headed
scripts.docker:full-run: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:run && allure serve allure-results
